response.sql:
WITH votes AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS country,
         1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max AS ratio
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
  WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max > 0
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM votes
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM country_avg) AS ratio_to_mean_of_countries
FROM country_avg
ORDER BY country;

assumptions.assumption: 'Award-vote record' means rows of player_award_vote. manager_award_vote also has player_id, so this is a choice; the request's 'its player' wording points to player awards.
A blank death_country is NULL or whitespace-only; all such players form one group labeled ''.
A ratio can't be computed when points_won is NULL or points_max is NULL or 0; those votes are excluded before averaging.
Each country's average is an unweighted mean over its vote-level ratios, and the cross-country mean is an unweighted mean of those country averages, including the blank-country group.
Division uses 1.0 * points_won so the ratio is not truncated to an integer.

alternatives.interpretation: Pool the votes from both player_award_vote and manager_award_vote before matching to player.
alternatives.sql:
WITH all_votes AS (
  SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM player_award_vote
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM manager_award_vote
),
votes AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS country,
         1.0 * a.points_won / a.points_max AS ratio
  FROM all_votes a
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
  WHERE a.points_won IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max > 0
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM votes
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM country_avg) AS ratio_to_mean_of_countries
FROM country_avg
ORDER BY country;
